entities.summary: Akane Shibata is a Japanese field hockey player born in Nikkō. At the 2012 Summer Olympics she competed with the Japan women's national field hockey team in the women's tournament. She also played for Japan at the 2016 Summer Olympics. Akane Shibata was a athletes & competitors from Nikkō-shi (b. 1988-04-30, Nikkō-shi). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
